title: Explain how to design the no result experience
body:
*From our customer support*

When there is no results, we only show a simple message / template. However it could also show the results of the empty query. This is not trivial but it could help going back to a search flow for users.

 - [ ] First iteration: only custom template + if no result, link to clear all filters
 - [ ] Second iteration: go deeper, provide custom widget examples for advanced use case (current refinements, display empty search...)

comments.body:
Proposed possible experience:
 - Display a message
 - Let the user clear all the filters
 - Display the current filters
 - Display the empty search
...
Would be really awesome to explain how to plug popular searches from here. cc @Jerskouille
Indeed @Shipow, I already asked @Jerskouille but it seems we're not there yet. It'll be for the third iteration of the guide :)
This has been shipped with v2.1.0, you can find the guide [here](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/guides/no-result.html)
